title: PREMARKET LIVE: The Trading Floor | Live Trading CPI Data Release
speaker: Arete Trading host

macro_themes.view: CPI, core and MoM all came in hot across the board; 'bad numbers'.
Fed leaning toward more rate hikes; 'no way they don't raise rates in October'.
Firmus failing to go public / Nvidia lending changed the fundamentals; neocloud/bitcoin-miner AI names in trouble.
Breadth deteriorating faster than any historical precedent he knows; he shorted the market and semis.

calls.condition: If ES undercuts the October low and then bounces, that flush is the buy setup he wants.
calls.reason: Hot CPI; expects open around 14 RSI with everyone short, likely bounce off the open; ideal is a flush under October low then bounce. He is short the market and semis.
calls.quote: you want to undercut and flush, and then look for a bounce... if you get undercut the October low and then bounce

calls.reason: Dealers lowered call wall to 1000 and put wall to 900; 950 magnet weaker; hot inflation and overseas risks make bounces unreliable.
calls.quote: Gun to my head, you probably crack and you're you're probably going lower.

calls.quote: Yeah, so I'm short NBIS. Um I I just think that it's a dumpster fire.
